en: For each index ⟦0⟧ (potential fourth element) it scans earlier indices ⟦1⟧. It maintains ⟦2⟧, the number of indices ⟦1⟧ where ⟦3⟧. When ⟦3⟧, the current ⟦4⟧ (triples ending at ⟦1⟧) are added to the result. When ⟦5⟧, ⟦2⟧ is added to ⟦4⟧, preparing triples that can later be closed by a larger element. The nested loops run in ⟦6⟧ time and ⟦7⟧ extra space.
ru: Har index ⟦0⟧ (potential fourth element) ke liye pehle wale indices ⟦1⟧ scan karta hai. Ye ⟦2⟧ maintain karta hai, un indices ⟦1⟧ ki tadaad jahan ⟦3⟧ ho. Jab ⟦3⟧ ho, current ⟦4⟧ (⟦1⟧ par khatam hone wali triples) result mein add ho jati hain. Jab ⟦5⟧ ho, ⟦2⟧ ko ⟦4⟧ mein add kiya jata hai, un triples ko prepare karte hue jo baad mein ek bare element se close ho sakein. Nested loops ⟦6⟧ time aur ⟦7⟧ extra space mein chalte hain.

en: Initialize the sum with 1 (the smallest proper divisor). Loop div from 2 up to √num; when div divides num, add both div and its complement num/div to the sum, taking care to add only once when they are ⟦0⟧. Return the accumulated sum.
ru: Sum ko 1 (sabse chota proper divisor) se initialize karta hai. div ko 2 se √num tak loop karta hai; jab div, num ko divide kare, sum mein div aur uska complement num/div dono add karta hai, isskha khayal rakhte hue ke jab wo ⟦0⟧ hon toh sirf ek dafa add ho. Accumulated sum return karta hai.

ru: a aur ⟦0⟧ ke darmiyan exclusive distance aur b se wapas ⟦1⟧ tak wrap-around distance compute karta hai. Agar distances barabar hon toh configuration symmetric hoti hai aur 0 obtuse angles deti hai; warna in dono distances mein se chota wala return karta hai.

ru: Do integer vectors ki kisi bhi non-empty subsequences ka maximum dot product calculate karta hai.

en: ⟦0⟧ computes the sum of all divisors of n by scanning up to √n and adding divisor pairs, then adds 1 and n. ⟦1⟧ calls ⟦0⟧, rejects ⟦2⟧, and finally checks that n and its divisor sum are coprime using gcd.
ru: ⟦0⟧ √n tak scan karke aur divisor pairs add karke n ke tamam divisors ka sum compute karta hai, phir 1 aur n add karta hai. ⟦1⟧, ⟦0⟧ ko call karta hai, ⟦2⟧ ko reject karta hai, aur akhir mein gcd istemal karke check karta hai ke n aur uska divisor sum coprime hain.

en: Scan the string left‑to‑right until a non‑prime digit is found. Move left to the first digit that can be decreased to a lower prime, replace it, and fill all later positions with '7'. If no such digit exists, shorten the string and fill with '7's.
ru: String ko left-to-right scan karta hai jab tak koi non-prime digit na mile. Us pehle digit tak left jata hai jise kisi lower prime tak decrease kiya ja sake, use replace karta hai, aur baad ki sab positions ko '7' se fill kar deta hai. Agar aisa koi digit na mile, string ko chota karta hai aur '7's se fill kar deta hai.

en: Writes to standard output either -1 or the constructed number as a string.
ru: Standard output par ya toh -1 likhta hai ya constructed number ko string ke tor par.

ru: r – result buffer ka pointer; a – pehle addend ka pointer; b – doosre ⟦0⟧ ka pointer.

en: If the list is empty, return. Otherwise, output the current node’s data, recursively call the function on the node two positions ⟦0⟧, then output the current node’s data again after the recursive call returns.
ru: Agar list empty ho, return kar deta hai. Warna, current node ka data output karta hai, do positions ⟦0⟧ wale node par function ko recursively call karta hai, phir recursive call wapas aane ke baad current node ka data dobara output karta hai.

ru: End se 'a' ki occurrences count karta hai aur string ko iterate karte hue 'a' aur 'b' ke counts maintain karta hai. Har step par 'a' aur 'b' ke counts ko balance karne ke liye required minimum deletions ko update karta hai.

ru: Puri 3-D triangulation par Marching Tetrahedra algorithm run karne ke liye aik convenient wrapper provide karta hai.

ru: Ye function check karta hai ke ek Binary Search ⟦0⟧ mein numbers ka koi pair mojood hai jo di gayi target value 'k' tak sum ho.

ru: Ye function ⟦0⟧ par iterate karke ek frequency map build karta hai. Phir ye map ko scan karta hai aur un keys ko collect karta hai jinka associated count ek ke barabar ho, unka natural order map se preserve karte hue.

ru: ⟦0⟧ – integers ka vector; ⟦1⟧ – ⟦2⟧.

en: First collect all divisors of k. While scanning nums, for each element e find the largest divisor d of k that also divides e; the needed partner divisor is k/d. The running frequency array f records how many earlier elements were divisible by each divisor, so we add ⟦0⟧ to the result. Then we increment f for every divisor that divides e.
ru: Pehle k ke sab divisors collect karta hai. nums ko scan karte hue, har element e ke liye k ka sabse bara divisor d dhoondta hai jo e ko bhi divide karta ho; zaroori partner divisor k/d hota hai. Running frequency array f record karta hai ke kitne pehle wale elements har divisor se divisible thay, isliye result mein ⟦0⟧ add karte hain. Phir e ko divide karne wale har divisor ke liye f ko increment karte hain.

en: Obtain an approximation object from the point’s kernel, compute an initial coarse bound, then iteratively increase the approximation precision until the interval’s size is ≤ bound, finally returning the resulting bounds.
ru: Point ke kernel se ek approximation object hasil karta hai, ek initial coarse bound compute karta hai, phir iteratively approximation precision barhata hai jab tak interval ka size bound se kam ya barabar na ho jaye, akhir mein resulting bounds return karte hue.

en: Replace every occurrence of character X with Y and remove all occurrences of character Z from a string.
ru: Ek string mein character X ke har occurrence ko Y se replace karta hai aur character Z ke sab occurrences remove kar deta hai.

ru: Iterator ka index hasil karne ke liye triangle range ke start se uska distance compute karta hai, assert karta hai ke index valid hai aur iterator stored triangle se match karta hai, phir result fetch karne ke liye patch-id vector mein index karta hai.

ru: floor use karke √N ka integer part calculate karta hai, phir next integer root hasil karne ke liye us mein 1 add karta hai. Is value ko square karke required perfect square hasil karta hai. Yeh N ≥ 0 ke liye kaam karta hai; negative N ke liye sqrt ka behavior undefined hai.

ru: ⟦1⟧ mein substring ke taur par appear hone wale ⟦0⟧ ke maximum consecutive repetitions ki tadaad calculate karta hai.

ru: √n ka integer ceiling compute karta hai, i = 1…⟦0⟧ ke liye sab quotients n / i ko ek set mein insert karta hai, phir numbers 0…(n / ⟦0⟧ − 1) insert karta hai. Akhir mein values output karne ke liye ordered set par iterate karta hai.

ru: Ek string se har '*' aur uske turant pehle wale character ko remove karta hai.

ru: Vector par running ⟦0⟧ calculate karta hai, ya to left-to-right ya right-to-left direction mein.

en: Split transactions into “negative” (payer > payee) and “positive” groups. Sort negatives by increasing payee and, on ties, decreasing payer; sort positives by decreasing payer. Simulate the negatives, tracking the worst deficit, then optionally apply the largest positive payer to reduce any remaining deficit. Return the maximum of the recorded deficit and any leftover negative balance.
ru: Transactions ko "negative" (payer > payee) aur "positive" groups mein split karta hai. Negatives ko increasing payee ke hisab se sort karta hai aur, ties par, decreasing payer ke hisab se; positives ko decreasing payer ke hisab se sort karta hai. Negatives ko simulate karta hai, worst deficit track karte hue, phir optionally kisi bhi remaining deficit ko reduce karne ke liye sabse bare positive payer ko apply karta hai. Recorded deficit aur kisi bhi leftover negative balance mein se maximum return kar deta hai.

ru: Numbers ko optimally order karke positive prefix sums ki count ke taur par define kiye gaye maximum possible score ko calculate karta hai.
